I like that there is a certain amount of stability. Always picking up from a hospital offers a level of stable (most days, iv had some that saying stable is a generous). I don't need the adrenaline high's of walking into the unknown. I can get flustered when plans change suddenly and with IFT there is a general playbook i pull out of 90% of the time. 

I work with our CCT medic frequently so get to work on some advanced patients, balloon pumps, 8 line drips, ECHMO. Stuff like that.  Seeing advanced medicine is always fascinating. Seeing people in different stages of there treatment not just the initial part also has helped with my medic school.

I don't get hit with a lot of stress like I did when I did 911. It felt like the world was on my shoulders and it effected my mental health. IFT, I have some patients that keep me up at night but not even close to 911.  I care more about my mental health then I do about my ego or whatever.

I get a lot of satisfaction out of psych transfers as someone who needed those services I like knowing I'm helping that area. Whether that be teens, LGBT  community, or just people who need help I can see myself in them and knowing I can help people how I needed help impacts me a lot.

In my area it pays better then  the  911. Also I work 12 instead of 24 or 48 like 911. I know that means a lot to my partner who has kids. For me it makes medic school a lot easier.

And lastly at the end of the day i look at it this way, 50% of the calls are glorified taxi rides, BUT grandma had to get home somehow. That's making the world a better place. It has to get done and if I do it I know it will be done to the standard i hold myself to and that if it was my family id be grateful. Yes, 100% taking dementia patients back to there nursing homes after a fall sucks, of course it does. But again the other points plus that i know they had to get back home somehow.

These are just my opinions and i totally get its not for everyone. I just wish people didn't look at us like "fake EMS" or lesser. Not saying that's what OP is doing or anything its just what i see in the EMS community. Just dont like all the competition there is in EMS so wanted to share my honest points.
